newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek FRNs firmer, one-year depos up in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek FRNs firmer, one-year depos up in late trade.

text.p: Greek seven-year FRNs continued to rise and were trading approximately one drachma higher in late Thursday dealings and one-year interbank depos traded around the 11.40 level, dealers said.
"Seven-year FRNs have been on a bull run and they were trading approximately one drachma higher in late trading," a state bank dealer said.
There was active dealing in one-year depos hovering around 11.40 points, dealers said.
Swaps were little changed holding Wednesday levels, dealers said.
"Ecu/drachma was trading slightly lower at 303.95/00 late on Thursday. There were some sales of ecus after the dollar rose versus the mark," dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 156.80/85 from Thursday's 156.820 fix, the dollar at 264.77/87 drachmas from 264.600 and the Ecu at 304.05/15 from 303.960 drachmas.
